name: pulse
description: Live meeting polls with real-time results, QR join, and one-vote-per-person.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pulse/server" "npm run dev -w @pulse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pulse/shared && npm run build -w @pulse/server && npm run build -w @pulse/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pulse/shared && npm run test -w @pulse/server
